content.short: Over Exposed is a premier digital art project on Cardano featuring unique NFT collections and membership.
content.description: Over Exposed is a distinguished digital artwork project on the Cardano blockchain, known for its high-quality NFT collections and community focus. The ecosystem includes a Genesis Digital membership, which grants holders exclusive perks and access to the project's long-term vision. Additionally, the Mekanism collection features 4,000 unique, non-auto-generated NFTs, including rare animated pieces with custom sound. By prioritizing artistic excellence and collector value, Over Exposed has established itself as a foundational creative project within the Cardano ecosystem.
